evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Firm aphoristic assertion with no hedges, but it argues a position rather than recording a settled decision; 'from now on' is the only operational marker and the lower region is taken per the claim/decision tear rule.
Memo record of the cadence as a settled operational arrangement, performed as a declarative in a decision document.
